themes.name: Correction Requires User-Driven Intent Revision Rather Than Mechanical Tool Failure
themes.central_concept: Episodes require correction when human users revise specifications, file targets, or design decisions mid-stream, whereas autonomous tool execution errors terminate without eliciting correction.
themes.limits: The synthetic corpus does not include multi-turn autonomous retry loops where agents correct their own tool failures without human steering.

questions_for_human: Should future iterations model human corrections responding directly to mechanical tool failures rather than exclusively to user specification revisions?
